subject.title: [Bug]: /context detail shows ~62k untracked provider/runtime overhead on fresh OpenAI Codex gpt-5.5 session

question: Should `/context detail` grow a provider-aware ledger for Codex residual tokens, and should any of those buckets affect context-window warnings or compaction behavior?
rationale: Source inspection shows the current generic residual display, but only maintainer/provider intent plus live Codex proof can decide the permanent bucket names and whether each bucket is billing-only, context-window occupancy, or unknown.

options.title: Keep open for provider-aware ledger
options.body: Implement the ledger only after live Codex usage evidence confirms how to classify cache, native thread state, provider scaffolding, and unknown residuals.

options.title: Document expected provider overhead
options.body: If live evidence shows the residual is expected and harmless, document that behavior and keep compaction semantics tied to the latest prompt snapshot.

options.title: Narrow to live reproduction first
options.body: Require a current-main Codex OAuth repro before deciding whether code or docs should change.

recommendation.title: Keep open for provider-aware ledger
recommendation.body: Implement the ledger only after live Codex usage evidence confirms how to classify cache, native thread state, provider scaffolding, and unknown residuals.
